title: Night stories
question: Tonight I feel…
intro: Short fairy tales for the hour before sleep, read by Julie.

ui.comingSoon: Julie is still writing this one. Coming soon.
ui.notOkayEnd: If tonight you feel like nobody would notice you were gone, please talk to someone now. Someone would notice. Someone would be glad you called.

feelings.label: Alone
feelings.line: Someone, somewhere, is keeping a light on for you.

feelings.label: Like I can't be myself
feelings.line: The real you is not too much and not too little.

feelings.label: Like I feel too much
feelings.line: Big feelings are a kind of strength, not a flaw.

feelings.label: Like I'm not enough
feelings.line: You don't have to earn your place at the table.

feelings.label: Like I've lost who I was
feelings.line: You can lose a path and still be the one walking.

feelings.label: Numb, like nothing
feelings.line: Feeling can come back slowly, like spring.

feelings.label: Scared of tomorrow
feelings.line: Tonight only asks you to rest.

feelings.label: Like nobody would notice if I disappeared
feelings.line: You are woven into more lives than you can see.

feelings.label: Missing someone
feelings.line: Missing someone is love that hasn't found where to go yet.

feelings.label: Like I failed
feelings.line: Ending is not the same as failing.

feelings.label: Homesick, in a new place
feelings.line: Home can be built again, one person at a time.
